docstring: An autonomous evaluation source question first receives independent IC-expert adjudication; ordinary source-bound review correction and proof still own acceptance.
pattern: A deterministic evaluation handoff names a human owner as the only next actor even when the evaluation role already delegates contextual hardware interpretation to an independent expert.
fix_action: Update the existing dispatcher handoff and issued-review guidance to name the independent IC expert, whole visible contract, discrepancy preservation and existing review correction. Retain honest unmeasured status, frozen input and all normal acceptance guards.
before_state: The actual resume consumer asks the specification owner for a missing definition and provides no autonomous expert-adjudication direction.
after_state: The same waiting task directs independent IC-expert adjudication and existing review correction without granting acceptance, repair or input mutation.
generality: The responsibility follows the evaluation role and whole visible contract. No design label, hidden reference or automatic semantic decision selects the result.
evidence: CAPTURE.md; external actual-resume red.xml/red-substance.json and matched owning receipts.

skill_title: Independent IC-expert adjudication during autonomous evaluation
why_not_bucket_a: Whether conflicting visible hardware clauses support a defensible interpretation is contextual IC design judgment. No regex, clause vote, universal source priority or benchmark lookup can decide it.
pattern: A visible contract contains conflicting or incomplete clauses, and an automated evaluation must distinguish a defensible source-bound engineering interpretation from behavior that the source cannot justify.
when: A source-bound review question interrupts an autonomous hardware evaluation.
what: An independent IC expert considers the entire visible contract, preserves the discrepancy, explains the defensible interpretation and alternatives, and uses existing hash-bound review correction followed by fresh independent proof when justified. Do not ask the human to solve each evaluation case. Preserve unmeasured status when no interpretation is defensible.
example: A state diagram and its functional description disagree. Consider every visible grant, reset and priority constraint without a universal diagram or prose preference; preserve the original edge and justify the engineering reading before a fresh independent review.
generality: This role guidance applies to any visible hardware contract and grants no hidden-oracle authority, automatic acceptance, test waiver or direct RTL repair.
